items.mainDefect: A failed retry-count update can escape the catch block, abort the remaining batch, and return HTTP 500.

secondary.defect: The retry-limit deletion branch lacks an SMS method filter and can delete reminders for other methods.
The retry-limit deletion branch can delete scheduled reminders even when their scheduled date has not passed.

items.mainDefect: Updating retryCount from the findMany snapshot loses increments when cron runs overlap.

secondary.defect: The retry-limit deletion branch can delete a successfully scheduled reminder, orphaning its Twilio message and breaking later cancellation.
